🎛️ Feature Locker — UI Visibility Modes
🛡️ Protected Mode ON
When ON, Setup/Rates, Partners Ledger, Bin/Delete Actions Log and Audit Log always stay Visible for Admin/Manager roles and can't be Blurred or Hidden. Turn OFF to allow full custom Visible/Blurred/Hidden overrides on those 4 modules too.
Configure how each menu item appears per staff role — handy for tailoring the UI per client when commercializing. Visible works normally. Blurred greys the item out with a lock badge and shows an "Upgrade / Admin Authorization Required" tip on tap — the screen stays unreachable. Hidden removes it from the Sidebar/Dashboard entirely. Changes save instantly and apply live the moment that role is active.
🗂️ Sidebar Menu Structure — Parent/Child Dropdowns
Turn any feature into a dropdown parent and pick which other sidebar items should nest under it as children. The sidebar renders a smooth arrow next to the parent — tap it to expand/collapse. A feature can only belong to one parent at a time, and a feature already used as a parent can't also become a child. This is structural (applies to everyone) and works together with the Visibility Modes above — if a parent or child is Hidden for a role, the sidebar adjusts automatically.
Master PIN Lock (legacy per-feature PIN gate)
A separate, still-active system: turning this ON for a feature keeps it fully visible and clickable for everyone, but prompts for the Master PIN before it opens. Independent of the Visibility Modes above — use that for role-based show/hide/blur, use this for a shared PIN gate on top.
🔑 Staff & Branch Security Codes
Every staff member and branch gets a 4-digit Security Code automatically when they're created. Staff enter theirs on the Start Shift screen. Admins can view or change any code here — this table is your central place to restrict who can open a shift.

Dashboard & UI Privacy Controls (Blur Mode)
🌫️ Lock requires the Master PIN before a value is revealed. Blur hides it behind a tap-to-reveal blur with no PIN needed — a quick privacy screen for when a customer can see the counter. Hide goes further and completely conceals the item — it's removed from the dashboard entirely, with no blur and no tap-to-reveal, until you switch Hide back off. Lock and Blur can be used alone or combined (blurred by default, PIN required to un-blur); a revealed value automatically re-blurs after 5 seconds. Hide overrides both — a hidden item stays gone regardless of its Lock/Blur state. For the Cancel Session Button row specifically: Hide removes the button from active table cards entirely; Blur obscures it until tapped once to reveal; Lock leaves the button visible but requires the Cancel Session Authorization Code (or Master PIN) before the cancellation can be confirmed.
Item 🔒 Lock 🌫️ Blur 🚫 Hide
📜 A record of feature unlocks, access-denied attempts, and sensitive actions (expenses, branch/staff changes, PIN changes). Kept locally (last 2000 entries) and mirrored to Firestore's auditLog collection when Firebase is configured, so it survives even if this device's storage is cleared.
Activity Log
Time Staff Branch Action Details
🛰️ Every Start Shift / Shutdown Shift automatically records a server-timestamped login/logout entry with device info and (if location permission is granted) a reverse-geocoded location name. Login always proceeds even if location access is denied or unavailable — this is a passive record, not a blocking check. Entries marked ⚠️ local clock were recorded without Firebase configured, so their timestamp is this device's own clock and is not tamper-resistant — configure firebaseConfig for server-verified timestamps. IP addresses shown are best-effort only (see code comments) and should not be treated as tamper-proof without a server-side capture.
